text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Team Zenith is so strong. They just kept
speeding
past us one after another like
it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But it's okay, 'cause we'll win next time
for sure!
We just gotta work even harder
together! Right,
Rice?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice? What's wrong? You're as pale as a
ghost!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I know I'll just end up dragging you all
down, so
I... I'm quitting the team!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What?! Rice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days have passed since the
team's
devastating loss in their unofficial
match against
Team Zenith.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower has been absent from
training for the
past few sessions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since she stopped showing up, the rest
of the
team have lost all their
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm so worried about Rice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back on how upset she was right
after the
unofficial match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice was the one who inadvertently
kicked off the
initial confrontation, and
it was her race that
ultimately cemented
the team's loss.
choice_data_list: ライス、すごく責任を感じていたからな
ライス、すごく責任を感じていたからね
choice_data_list_en: Rice felt a huge sense of responsibility, after all.
Rice felt a huge sense of responsibility, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To her, it must seem as if the whole
situation was
her fault alone.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
During the final race that day, I kept
cheerin' her
on and tellin' her to do her
best...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But in the state she was in, that probably
just
added to her nerves...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on winnin', I didn't even
realize
how anxious she was...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle sighs quietly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If we weren't walkin' on eggshells 'round
each
other all the time, maybe things
wouldn't have
gotten this way...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was scared of messin' up the
team's
groove, so I held back on buggin'
the others,
even though I wanted to
hang out and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember the party Taiki Shuttle had
organized.
Usually, she would've
barreled on ahead
regardless of
everything and invited everyone to
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just her. The whole team has
been
trying so hard to keep the peace,
it's kept them
from acting like
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scales fall from my eyes, and I'm
ashamed at
how long it took me to
realize why our team
dynamic has been
suffering.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It probably wasn't healthy for us to keep

tiptoeing 'round each other like that,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm proud of them for making an effort
to be
mature and put others first. We
couldn't function
as a team without that
kind of attitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if we want to truly shine, everyone
must
perform at their own individual
best without
holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that their individuality is what
makes
them special—that they should
stop repressing
themselves just to avoid
rocking the boat.
choice_data_list: 今日から遠慮はやめよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's stop holding back starting today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You think it's okay to... just be
ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle brightens any room she
enters with
her energy, and she's
incredibly astute when it
comes to other
people's emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she could quickly become the
cement
that keeps the team together if
she stops hiding
that bright spirit of hers
away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If everyone uses their strengths to cover
for each
other's weaknesses, claiming
victory will become
less of a far-fetched
dream.

text_block_list.name: Team Members
choice_data_list: 絶対いいチームになれる
choice_data_list_en: We can definitely become a great team.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I thought being part of a team was all
about
keeping everyone on the same
page, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Being frank with each other! And acting
like
ourselves! I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? Would it be all right for
me to talk
more, then?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was doing my very best to keep quiet
during
training, but it was hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's strength lies in her genuine
nature
and boundless positive energy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt she'll be the one to
keep the
team feeling optimistic even
when things get
tough.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay!
choice_data_list: どんどんお喋りしよう！

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd like to offer my fortune-telling
services!
And I'll divine all the info about
lucky dashes that
I can!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it always made me uneasy
when we
ended up running in less lucky
directions...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru's passion for lucky
dashes
and fortune-telling is far from
conventional, but
that unique charm will
surely bring new
perspectives to the
team.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much!
choice_data_list: どんどんやっていこう！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We've got Urara supportin' the team and

Fukukitaru's keepin' things fresh!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm super-duper pumped now! I bet
we're gonna
be the best in the west!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Haha! Yeah!
choice_data_list_en: I know you can become one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let's go find Rice, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She's a valuable member of the team
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Riiice! Where are you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Rice! We just wanna talk!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
According to my pencil divination, the
person
we're looking for is near a tree.
Which means she
must be... right here!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Wh-what is it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Rice, there's somethin' important we
gotta tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-but I'm not part of the team anymore.
I said I
was going to quit...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I thought you were just considering
it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm a horrible runner who can't even win
any
races... I'd only be a burden to you
all if I stayed...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The team would be better off without
me...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about?! We need
you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, you don't... I'll just make you all lose
again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as Rice Shower berates herself
mercilessly,
her teammates do their best
to cheer her up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it seems we may have been too late
to reach
her. Rice remains determined to
stick by her
decision, until...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aha! I just had a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today's lucky direction is south! And
today's
lucky item is sea salt!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it'd be extremely
auspicious for us
to run toward Enoshima
right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Completely unfazed by our collective
blank
stares, Matikanefukukitaru
continues on
cheerfully.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's only about forty kilometers from the
academy!
It's a bit far, but it shouldn't
be a problem for us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It'll be really great training, and I bet all
your
worries will just fly away to the sky
on our way
over, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-you want us to run... all the way to
Enoshima?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru's suggestion is so
unexpected
that it manages to transform
Rice Shower's
sadness into confusion.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Fuku, that sounds great! I'd love
to go to
the beach with you guys!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-not you too, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm pretty clever, aren't I? After
we're done
at the beach, we can have
some of Enoshima's
famous whitebait
bowls before we come back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw! I'm likin' what I'm hearin'!
C'mon, let's
get goin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But before Taiki Shuttle can get far,
Rice Shower
stops her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Taiki! Wait, please!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What's up?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's already so late... By the time
we get
there it'll be night...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We shouldn't run in the dark! It's
dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The team falls silent.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... guys?

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Good point!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're totally right, Rice! It'd be
reckless
for us to do such a long run at
night!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was a close one. Thank goodness
we have
you to be our voice of reason!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We'd be a right mess if you weren't
around to
keep us in line, Rice. I'm tellin'
ya, we need you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You... do?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer gave us a pep talk and said we
should be
more honest with each other.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, if we stick true to ourselves,
we'll be
able to make our team
super-duper strong!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That careful and thoughtful attitude of
yours is
what keeps our team safe!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heh! Just like you did a hot second ago!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pallor of Rice Shower's face slowly
gives way
to a healthy flush.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Are... are you sure you want me in your
team?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course we do. We won't win a single
race
without you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Besides, things are way more fun
with you
around!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll—I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Rice Shower returns to our
training
sessions.
